questions.q: The region has abundant rain in July but ___ rain in March.
questions.e: Scarce est le contraire d’abundant : rare est le contraire d’abondant.

questions.q: The glass is transparent, while the painted panel is ___.
questions.e: Opaque est le contraire de transparent.

questions.q: She was reluctant to speak at first, but later became ___ to share her view.
questions.e: Willing est le contraire de reluctant : disposé est le contraire d’hésitant.

questions.q: When the temperature rises, metal may expand; when it cools, it may ___.
questions.e: Contract est le contraire de expand : se contracter est le contraire de se dilater.

questions.q: The museum works to preserve old documents, not ___ them.
questions.e: Destroy est le contraire de preserve.

questions.q: He remained optimistic, while his colleague was ___.
questions.e: Pessimistic est le contraire de optimistic.

questions.q: A rigid plan allows little change; a ___ plan can be adapted.
questions.e: Flexible est le contraire de rigid : souple est le contraire de rigide.

questions.q: The reviewer praised the book rather than ___ it.
questions.e: Criticize est le contraire de praise dans ce contexte.

questions.q: Keep the records you need and ___ the duplicates.
questions.e: Discard est le contraire de retain : jeter est le contraire de garder.

questions.q: The first instruction is explicit, whereas the second is ___.
questions.e: Implicit est le contraire de explicit : sous-entendu est le contraire d’explicite.

questions.q: The vote was unanimous, but the earlier vote was ___.
questions.e: Divided s’oppose à unanimous : les avis n’étaient pas tous les mêmes.
Permanent est le contraire de temporary.

questions.q: Attendance is mandatory for this meeting, but optional for the next one.
questions.e: Optional est le contraire de mandatory : facultatif est le contraire d’obligatoire.

questions.q: The group endorsed the proposal; another group chose to ___ it.
questions.e: Oppose est le contraire d’endorse : s’opposer est le contraire de soutenir.

questions.q: The final score exceeded the target; the first score fell ___ it.
questions.e: Below exprime l’opposé d’exceeding the target dans cette phrase.

questions.q: The guide was friendly, although the guard seemed ___.
questions.e: Hostile est le contraire de friendly.

questions.q: The noise diminished after the doors closed, then began to ___.
questions.e: Increase est le contraire de diminish.

questions.q: The first result was valid, but the second was declared ___.
questions.e: Invalid est le contraire de valid.

questions.q: Her argument was coherent, unlike the earlier, ___ explanation.
questions.e: Incoherent est le contraire de coherent.

questions.q: A judge should remain impartial, not ___.
questions.e: Biased est le contraire d’impartial : partial est le contraire d’impartial.

questions.q: The policy may inhibit discussion, while a safe space can ___ it.
questions.e: Encourage est le contraire d’inhibit dans ce contexte.

questions.q: The explanation is plausible, but the second claim is ___.
questions.e: Implausible est le contraire de plausible.

questions.q: The path ascends the hill, then ___ toward the river.
questions.e: Descends est le contraire de ascends.

questions.q: The benevolent leader supported the families; a ___ ruler would harm them.
questions.e: Malevolent est le contraire de benevolent : malveillant s’oppose à bienveillant.
